novel_features.name: Branch directions URLs
novel_features.description: Get a ready-to-open Google Maps directions link for every branch of a restaurant at once.
novel_features.rationale: Reads a merchant's branches from the live API and composes the site's Google Maps daddr URL for every branch at once, instead of clicking each Direction button.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent or user needs map links or coordinates for a chain's outlets in bulk.

novel_features.name: Nearest branch
novel_features.description: Find the single closest branch of a restaurant to a city or coordinates, with its directions link.
novel_features.rationale: Fetches a merchant's branches and computes haversine distance against a resolved city/coordinate reference to pick the closest; no single API call ranks branches by distance.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when routing someone to the closest outlet of a chain.

novel_features.name: Card to merchants
novel_features.description: List every merchant in a city that honors a given bank card's deal (card to merchants).
novel_features.rationale: Fans out across a city's deal-bearing merchants and their deals to invert the site's merchant-to-card relation into card-to-merchants.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for card-led planning: which places accept my bank's discount.

novel_features.name: Top deals ranking
novel_features.description: Rank a city's merchants by discount percentage and return the biggest current discounts.
novel_features.rationale: Fans out across a city's deal-bearing merchants, collects every deal, and ranks them by discount percentage; no cross-merchant aggregation endpoint exists upstream.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to find the single biggest valid discount in a city without opening merchant pages one by one.

novel_features.name: Expiring deals
novel_features.description: List deals whose validity window closes within N days.
novel_features.rationale: Fans out across a city's merchants, collects their deals, and filters by end-date window; no cross-merchant deals feed exists upstream.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to catch use-it-or-lose-it offers before they expire.

novel_features.name: Open now
novel_features.description: Keep only merchants with a branch open at the current local time.
novel_features.rationale: Filters the city's trending merchant listing to those Peekaboo reports open at the current time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for 'where can I eat right now' queries.

narrative.headline: Every Peekaboo deal, branch, and bank-card offer from the terminal — plus city-wide deal ranking, bank-card reverse lookup, and bulk branch map-link export the Peekaboo site has no button for.
narrative.value_prop: Peekaboo Guru lists restaurant and retail deals, bank-card discounts, and store branches across Pakistan. This CLI wraps its full API with zero-config guest auth and adds commands the site can't do in one step: rank a whole city's discounts with top-deals, invert bank-card deals into card-to-merchant lookups with wallet, find the nearest branch of a chain with nearest, and export Google Maps directions for every branch with directions.
narrative.auth_narrative: No signup or API key. Peekaboo serves a public guest token embedded in every page; the CLI fetches and caches it automatically on first use, so commands just work.

quickstart.comment: confirm the CLI is wired up
find your city (982 available); auto-auth kicks in here
browse food deals in a city
Google Maps links for every branch of a restaurant (id from places list)

troubleshoots.symptom: 401 Unauthorized on any command except locations
troubleshoots.fix: run 'peekaboo-pp-cli bootstrap' to refresh the cached guest token

troubleshoots.symptom: empty results from top-deals, wallet, or expiring
troubleshoots.fix: raise --max-scan-pages and --max-merchants to scan more merchants, or lower --min-discount

troubleshoots.symptom: requests start failing after many rapid calls
troubleshoots.fix: Peekaboo rate-limits bursts; wait a few seconds and retry — the CLI paces automatically

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent or user needs to discover Pakistan deals and discounts, compare or rank offers across merchants in a city, look up which bank cards give discounts where, or get coordinates and Google Maps directions for a restaurant chain's branches. It is strongest for city-scoped deal ranking and bulk branch geolocation, which the Peekaboo website cannot do in one step.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to redeem, apply, or purchase deals — it is read-only discovery.
Do not use it for deals outside Peekaboo's coverage (it is Pakistan-focused).
Do not use it to manage a Peekaboo user account or write reviews.
